Rekindling the Verdant Years Chapter 74: Can You Be My Boyfriend?

"What are you guys talking about?"

Ying Chanxi finished her shower, changed into a cute pink pajama set, and walked out with her wet feet in slippers. A white towel was on her head as she dried her hair, and she asked the two in the living room.

Li Luo saw her come out, so he got up and went into the kitchen to dish out the fried noodles for her, bringing them to the dining table.

Xu Youyu glanced at Li Luo, sighed, and complained to Ying Chanxi, "The other vice president of the literature club invited him to join, and he just rejected her outright."

"I said I knew him, so the president asked me to give it a try too. Who knew he'd be so ungracious."

Li Luo pushed the fried noodles in front of Ying Chanxi and subconsciously took out a hairdryer from the drawer nearby. He plugged it in, walked behind Ying Chanxi, and took the towel off her head.

Hearing what Xu Youyu said, he immediately rolled his eyes. "Didn't I still agree in the end?"

"You agreed?" Ying Chanxi was about to take her first bite of fried noodles when she heard this. She immediately turned her head to look at Li Luo behind her.

"Just talk." Li Luo silently wiped his face, drying the water flicked onto him by her hair, and pressed her head to turn it back. "Don't move your head around."

"Oh." Ying Chanxi turned her head back, puffing her cheeks. "Someone said this evening that he didn't want to join the literature club. I asked someone to join with me, and he wasn't happy about it."

"Heh heh." Li Luo chuckled and tapped her on the head twice. "If you're willing to take over cleaning duties for a month, then I'm willing too."

"Huh?" Ying Chanxi paused, then looked at Xu Youyu across from her.

Noticing Ying Chanxi's gaze, Xu Youyu immediately rolled her eyes. "This guy originally wanted me to wash his clothes for a month! So shameless."

"That is indeed shameless." Ying Chanxi's face tightened. She felt that if she had to choose, she would probably pick the laundry option.

"Isn't washing clothes easier than cleaning?" Li Luo analyzed with a straight face. "It's not like we don't have a washing machine at home."

"Heh heh." Xu Youyu buried her head in her fried noodles, too lazy to argue with him over such trivial matters.

Anyway, when she was renting this place before, she had already agreed with a few senior students on weekly cleaning duties.

Now, she was just taking over everything herself.

Besides, the apartment never got that dirty. The few of them were usually at school, so only the kitchen and bathroom needed cleaning. The other areas were very clean.

Just then, Li Luo's phone, which was on the table, started to vibrate.

Ying Chanxi was enjoying Li Luo's blow-drying service while eating her noodles. Hearing the phone vibrate, she considerately picked it up for him.

"You have a call."

"Oh." Li Luo turned off the hairdryer and took the phone. He saw it was a call from Yan Zhusheng and felt a little dazed, wondering why she would be calling at this hour.

The moment he answered, he heard Yan Zhusheng on the other end say, "Li Luo, I really like you. Can you go out with me?"

Li Luo: "...What are you doing?"

"Recording a song," Yan Zhusheng said honestly. "Hurry up and reject me."

"No... don't you live at school? How can you record a song in your dorm room?" Li Luo replied, completely speechless. Then, he very naturally placed the hairdryer on the table and walked toward the bedroom.

After entering the bedroom and closing the door, Li Luo heard Yan Zhusheng answer, "I asked a teacher for a leave of absence. I'm at home now."

"So?"

"I asked a teacher to make a classical-style arrangement, so I can record 'Annual Rings' now," Yan Zhusheng said. "I need to get into the mood."

Li Luo covered his forehead, a pained expression on his face, then took a deep breath. "Go on, I'm ready."

"Okay." Yan Zhusheng nodded and said again, "Li Luo, I really like you. Can you be my boyfriend?"

"Sorry, I don't plan on being in a relationship right now," Li Luo rejected her coldly.

The moment he finished speaking, the call was disconnected.

Li Luo looked down at his phone in surprise, thinking, "Damn, that was fast."

Use and toss, huh?

But complaints aside, Li Luo still approved of Yan Zhusheng's professional ability.

He had gone to Yan Zhusheng's home on Sunday, and now it was only Tuesday. The most basic arrangement was already done, and she could already start recording the vocal parts.

It was just that the timing was truly explosive.

Thank goodness he didn't put it on speaker in the living room just now. Otherwise, if Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu heard Yan Zhusheng's confession, Li Luo dared not imagine how explosive the effect would have been.

Putting the phone in his pocket, Li Luo walked out of the bedroom and picked up the hairdryer again.

Ying Chanxi, who was eating her fried noodles, asked doubtfully, "Who was that calling just now?"

"Yan Zhusheng."

"Huh?" Xu Youyu was also full of curiosity. "She called you at this hour?"

"Yeah." Li Luo nodded and explained, "She took a leave of absence and went home. She was helping me with some arrangement stuff."

Li Luo didn't mention the song "Annual Rings."

He had told Yan Zhusheng to record this song before, precisely because he didn't want others to know he had written it.

After all, Xu Youyu had read his novel. If the song "Annual Rings" came out and they made the connection, wouldn't she be able to guess immediately that he was Rekindle?

That was absolutely not allowed.

And as for Ying Chanxi, Li Luo was mainly afraid his mom would slip up and accidentally let her find out.

With Ying Chanxi's personality, if she found out he wrote an web novel, even if she didn't normally read them, she would definitely go take a look.

So right now, Li Luo was trying to hide it for as long as he could.

Whenever he was truly exposed, he would just drag Xu Youyu down with him.

If he was going down, Sister Zao Shui couldn't live on unscathed!

With that thought, Li Luo's mood instantly improved.

Ying Chanxi, eating her fried noodles, said, "Then you have to treat her well. When we go to her house on Saturday, let's buy some groceries to bring over."

"Alright, I'll let her know then."

Yuhang City Center, Huayue Pictures.

Outside a high-end recording studio.

By the time Ying Zhicheng finished his work, it was already past nine in the evening.

On his way out, he passed by the company's recording studio and noticed the lights were still on, which made him stop.

The secretary beside him saw this and immediately reminded him, "That's probably Yuan Wanqing recording a song. She's been working hard on her new album recently."

"Oh, did the song solicitation go smoothly before?" Ying Zhicheng walked toward the studio door and asked casually.

"Yes, ten songs have been confirmed for this album."

"That's good." Ying Zhicheng nodded, then walked to the studio door and knocked.

Soon, the door was opened from the inside.

"Wanqing, still recording so late?" Ying Zhicheng saw the female singer inside, who looked to be in her thirties, and said with a smile.

"It's not that late." Although Yuan Wanqing was already thirty-eight, she had maintained herself well and looked to be about twenty-seven or twenty-eight. Seeing Ying Zhicheng come in, she smiled politely. "After all, I can't betray CEO Ying's trust."

"Trust is not that important. Your health is what matters most. Now that you've finally recovered from your heart condition, you should pay more attention to your rest," Ying Zhicheng said as he walked into the studio and sat down on the sofa.

"Yes, I'm almost done recording anyway. I'll head back after a short break." Yuan Wanqing poured Ying Zhicheng a glass of water, and the two began to chat.

At the beginning of the century, Yuan Wanqing had been Huayue Pictures' leading lady in the music scene, having sung many popular and well-known songs.

Unfortunately, her good fortune didn't last. In 2003, she was diagnosed with a heart condition. She spent several years abroad for treatment and then several more recuperating in the country before her condition finally stabilized.

Now, after more than a decade, Yuan Wanqing planned to return to the public eye, and Ying Zhicheng had also made arrangements for it.

And just as the two were chatting, Luo Fei, the recording engineer who was helping Yuan Wanqing, was bored and hummed a little tune.

As it happened, Yuan Wanqing had sharp ears. She couldn't help but turn to look at her good friend Luo Fei and ask with confusion, "What song are you humming? It doesn't seem to be from my album, does it?"

"Huh?" Luo Fei was taken aback for a moment, then said, "Oh, this? It's a song your Zhusheng asked me to arrange. I was just humming a few lines."

"Didn't she go to school?" Yuan Wanqing frowned. "A song she wrote herself?"

"I'm not sure about that. Probably." Luo Fei shrugged. "It's just a pop song, with a bit of a classical style."

"Oh?" The nearby Ying Zhicheng raised his eyebrows with interest. "Your daughter can write songs too? Can I have a listen?"

"Sure," Yuan Wanqing said with a nod. "Feifei, play it."

"One moment." Luo Fei made an OK gesture and said with a smile, "She just sent over a version today. Perfect for a listen."

A moment later, Yan Zhusheng's melodious voice, tinged with a faint sadness, filled the recording studio.

It was just a few short minutes.

The few of them were immersed in Yan Zhusheng's singing.

After listening, Ying Zhicheng silently savored it for a moment, then suddenly said, "The company has a xianxia romance drama recently, and we're currently looking for a theme song. Why not have your daughter submit this song and give it a try?"

"Hmm?" Yuan Wanqing was stunned. "Is that okay?"

"We're just soliciting, so it's not guaranteed to be chosen." Ying Zhicheng smiled. "There's no harm in trying."

"Then I'll have to trouble CEO Ying."

"No trouble at all. This song sounds quite good. At the very least, the melody is catchy and has the potential to be a hit." As Ying Zhicheng said this, he stood up and spoke to his secretary, "Make a note of this. We'll be leaving now. You all should get some rest too."

"Alright, take care, CEO Ying."

Yuan Wanqing saw Ying Zhicheng off, then turned around to look at Luo Fei.

"I'll make a copy later and give it to CEO Ying's secretary," Luo Fei said.

"You can handle that." Yuan Wanqing smiled, then her expression instantly changed as she asked abruptly, "Feifei, do you think... Zhusheng is in a relationship?"

(End of Chapter)
